name: Sonam Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2001, Sonam Clock Ltd does manufacturing & trading of Horological items, Clocks, Clock Movements and related items[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SCL is a ISO 9001: 2000 certified company offering a wide range of table and wall clocks at various price points across budget, mid-level and premium styles. It sells 1400+ various types of wall clock, clock movements, and LED digital clock products in 25+ countries via 150+ Distributors and 35000+ Retailers. Company offers customized corporate clocks in bulk quantities for corporate gifting purpose

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Promoter holding has increased by 1.17% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 2.85 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.7% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.65% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -17.0%
